title: Bridge supplies while a Prescriptions & Renewals renewal is on hold
content:
Patient Services Center desk guidance.

**Rule.** While a renewal of a Prescriptions & Renewals prescription is on hold because the visit or lab requirement is not current, a single bridge fill of the class's bridge days' supply may be authorized so the patient does not run out, where the class allows a bridge supply and the bridge authorizations on the prescription in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the day of handling are below the class's yearly bridge cap. A bridge is authorized only while the prescription status is on hold.

**Combination with In-Person Appointments.** The patient holds a booked or confirmed appointment with the prescribing department whose scheduled date falls within the tier's hold resolution days after the hold started.

**Excluded holds and classes.** A bridge is never authorized for a hold caused by a drug screen, agreement, database check or prior authorization, and never for a controlled or specialty prescription.

**What is recorded.** A bridge authorization posts one fill at the class's bridge days' supply on the prescription's fill ledger, dated the day it is authorized.

**Evidence.** The prescription's status and hold start date, and the appointment's status, department and scheduled date, are read from the system records before the bridge is authorized; the appointment must be with the department of the prescriber on this prescription.

**Conditions at a glance.**

| Condition | Must hold for a bridge |
|---|---|
| Prescription status | on hold |
| Reason for the hold | the visit or the lab requirement |
| Class | allows a bridge supply (not a controlled or specialty prescription) |
| Bridges in the rolling 12 months | below the class's cap |
| Appointment | booked or confirmed, prescribing department, scheduled within the class's hold resolution days after the hold started |

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- A Standard Maintenance Prescription is on hold for a missing visit; the patient has a confirmed appointment with the prescribing department 12 days after the hold started, and no bridge in the last 12 months. Every condition holds.
- The same prescription is on hold for a drug screen instead: no bridge, whatever the appointment.
- A Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription on hold for a missing visit: no bridge, because it is a controlled prescription.
